---
description: Coding best practices — always apply when generating, planning, or reviewing code.
applyTo: "**"
---

- Follow KISS and DRY principles.
- Follow the current best practices and architectural patterns of the project's frameworks.
- No unnecessary code comments; code should be self-explanatory.
- Variable names: camelCase. Constants/readonly values: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.
- Prioritize maintainability, readability, and extensibility.
- Avoid unnecessary computation or redundant work.
- Avoid third-party libraries for simple functionality — only add packages when genuinely justified.
